# wotoEAT

> A free AI meal planner that answers one question: what should I cook with
> what I already have? Web, iOS and Android, English and Simplified Chinese.

wotoEAT takes your health profile, your pantry contents and a few filters, and
suggests one real, cookable dish at a time with the full recipe and macros.
Confirmed meals become a shopping list with pantry items already subtracted.
A grocery receipt can be photographed to fill the pantry. Allergies and dietary
restrictions are treated as hard constraints on every suggestion.

It is free, needs no credit card, and can be tried without an account.

## Notes
- Built by Jerry Wang. No analytics, advertising or tracking anywhere in the app.
- Recipes are AI-generated. Anyone with a food allergy should check the
  ingredients themselves before cooking.
